picks.title: OpenAI co-founder Andrej Karpathy joins Anthropic
picks.why_it_matters: A top-tier AI researcher moving from OpenAI to Anthropic signals shifting talent dynamics in the foundation model race and could reshape competitive positioning among AI infrastructure players that startups build on.

picks.title: From teen hacker to Iron Dome researcher, this founder raised $28M to fight AI phishing
picks.why_it_matters: A $28M raise for AI-native email security validates the emerging category of defensive AI tools built to counter AI-generated threats—a market likely to expand as phishing attacks become more sophisticated.

picks.title: Stilta raises $10.5M from a16z and YC to help companies rediscover the patents they forgot they had
picks.why_it_matters: Top-tier investors backing AI-powered legal tech just months after launch suggests strong early traction and growing appetite for AI automation in traditionally manual, high-margin professional services.
